paragraphs.text: Kamat was a Naga warrior from Naktamun on the plane of Amonkhet , and an initiate of Tah crop.

As part of the Tah crop, Kamat embarked upon the Trial of Ambition . Although she made it to the last chamber, overseen by Bontu herself, she did not survive the last culling, and her heart was claimed by Neit , who was one of four crop members to complete the trial.
